_instructions: This file is the schema library the Schemas tab loads. To add a schema, append an object to schemas with a stable id, a name, a short description, and a JSON Schema in schema. Use type object and properties for a component field list. Property types are string, number, integer, or boolean. Put required names in required. Use oneOf when a component accepts different shapes, as Media does for an image (alt) and a video (poster). To attach a schema to an example component, set assignments to { documentId: schemaId }. Document ids match the example file names: input, textarea, card, media. Reload the editor after editing this file. A schema changed in the browser is stored in local storage and then overrides this file for that id.

schemas.name: Input
schemas.description: Text control props from the Input component.

schemas.name: Textarea
schemas.description: Text control props from the Textarea component, including rows.

schemas.name: Image
schemas.description: Image shape taken from the Media component. Alt is the image-only field.

schemas.name: Video
schemas.description: Video shape taken from the Media component. Poster is the video-only field.

schemas.name: Card
schemas.description: Copy fields from the Card component.

schemas.name: Media
schemas.description: Union of an image and a video. A value matches exactly one branch.
